name: forkhead box O3

function.text: FOXO3 encodes forkhead box protein O3. Annotated molecular activities include mitochondrial transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in mitochondrial transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: FOXO3 rearrangement with KMT2A has been described in secondary acute leukemia.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
